title: 注册项目入口绕过项目成员边界
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: Authenticated actor with registrations.view for reads
Authenticated actor with registrations.update for demonstrated update path
Target is a live registration subtype project outside actor membership

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated PostgreSQL route probe with injected actor identity; not rerun this turn and not a full real-JWT flow.
Current code confirms shared missing membership/capability check; list/stats/stage/profile were not individually dynamically probed.

counterevidenceChecked: Authentication and route-level system permission are enforced.
Queries exclude non-registration and soft-deleted projects.
Stage transitions are allowlisted and generic profile paths reject direct stage changes.
Ordinary projects use membership visibility/access resolver; registration routes do not.
observedImpact: Historical isolated probe read a private task through registration detail as a nonmember and updated a project name through registration PUT with the required system permission.
potentialImpact: Other registration routes share the same scope helper; their exact response and mutation effects have not each been dynamically demonstrated.
recommendation: Apply the shared live-project visibility and project capability decision to registration list, stats, detail, update, stage, and profile operations; define any global registration visibility exception and align manager transfer with ProjectMember state.
acceptanceCriteria: Test list/stats/detail/update/stage/profile for missing system permission, member capability, nonmember, left member, deleted project, and SUPER_ADMIN exception.
Unauthorized operations return the documented status and leave project/profile state unchanged.
SUPER_ADMIN nonmember access follows the shared elevated audit policy.
Manager transfer updates or deliberately preserves membership according to an explicit policy.
pendingQuestions: Is registration project visibility intentionally global for actors with registrations.view? If so, define read fields, write scope, and audit policy.
